items.stem: Which of these calculates population density?
Aisha drives 30 km at 60 km/h and then another 30 km at 90 km/h. Aisha says the average speed for the whole journey is 75 km/h. Explain why Aisha is wrong and find the correct average speed.
items.answer: More time is spent at the slower speed, so you cannot average the speeds. Total time = 0.5 + 0.333333 = 0.833333 h; average = 60 ÷ 0.833333 = 72 km/h.
items.markingKey: B1 explanation; B1 correct average using total distance ÷ total time. [2]
